en.name: Pumpkin seeds, roasted, hulled
en.summary: Roasted hulled pumpkin seeds keep 6 months in a cool, dry cupboard. Refrigeration is not necessary for unsalted seeds, so an airtight jar in the pantry is the whole answer for most kitchens.
en.pantry: 6 months in an airtight, opaque jar, cool, dark and dry. Roasting drives off what little moisture the kernel held and deepens the flavour, but it also gives the oil a head start: heat begins the oxidation that eventually makes a seed taste bitter. Nothing grows in them, so this is a flavour window rather than a safety limit. Keep the jar out of the sun and away from the hob, and buy the quantity you will actually get through.
en.fridge: Refrigeration is not necessary for unsalted roasted pumpkin seeds, and no refrigerated timeline is published. A sealed jar in a cool cupboard reaches the 6-month figure on its own. Salted or oil-dressed seeds are a slightly different case — salt draws moisture from the air and oil-coated seeds go soft — and for those a cold, properly airtight jar is a reasonable precaution in a hot, humid kitchen.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published. Freezing does not harm roasted seeds, which hold almost no water, but the cupboard figure already covers half a year and the freezer buys nothing you need. If you have roasted a large batch at home, cool it completely before sealing — trapped steam is what turns a crisp seed leathery overnight.
en.thawing: Nothing to thaw. Let any chilled container reach room temperature before opening, so condensation does not soften the seeds.
spoilage: A bitter or fishy taste — roasted seed oil that has gone rancid.
A smell of old cooking oil or crayons rather than toasted and nutty.
Seeds that are chewy rather than crisp, which means moisture got in.
Mould or a musty smell in a jar that was sealed while still warm.
tips: Cool home-roasted seeds completely before you put the lid on.
Store in an opaque airtight jar; light and heat both push the oil along.
Roast in small batches rather than roasting a kilo at once.
Taste a few before scattering them on a salad or a soup.

faq.q: How long do roasted pumpkin seeds keep?
faq.a: 6 months in an airtight jar in a cool, dry, dark cupboard.

faq.q: Do roasted pumpkin seeds need to be refrigerated?
faq.a: Not if they are unsalted — refrigeration is not necessary, and no refrigerated timeline is published. Salted or oiled seeds benefit from a cold, airtight jar in a humid kitchen.

faq.q: How can you tell if roasted pumpkin seeds have gone bad?
faq.a: Taste a few. Rancid seeds are bitter and faintly fishy. Chewiness on its own is moisture, not spoilage.

zh.name: 烤南瓜籽仁（去殼）
zh.summary: 去殼的烤南瓜籽仁放在陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃可放 6 個月。無鹽的版本不需要冷藏，所以對多數廚房來說，一個氣密罐放櫥櫃就是全部的答案。
zh.pantry: 不透光的氣密罐，陰涼、避光、乾燥，6 個月。烘烤把種仁裡本來就不多的水分趕走、也讓香氣更深，但同時讓油脂搶跑了一段：加熱啟動了那個最後會讓種子發苦的氧化反應。裡面長不出東西，所以這是風味的窗口而不是安全的上限。罐子請避免日曬、遠離爐台，並且買你真的吃得完的量。
zh.fridge: 無鹽的烤南瓜籽仁不需要冷藏，也沒有公布冷藏期限。密封罐放陰涼櫥櫃，自己就能走到 6 個月。加鹽或拌了油的版本略有不同——鹽會把空氣中的水吸過來，裹油的種子則容易變軟——在又熱又濕的廚房裡，把那一類放進真正氣密的罐子再冷藏，是合理的保險。
zh.freezer: 沒有冷凍的期限數據。冷凍不會傷到烤過的種子，它幾乎不含水；但櫥櫃已經涵蓋半年，冷凍換不到你需要的東西。如果是自己在家烤了一大盤，請完全放涼再密封——困在裡面的蒸氣，正是讓酥脆的種子一夜之間變韌的原因。
zh.thawing: 沒有東西要解凍。冰過的容器請回到室溫再打開，免得結露把種子弄軟。
spoilage: 嚐起來發苦或帶腥味——那是烤過的種子油油耗了。
聞起來像久放的油或蠟筆，而不是烘香的堅果味。
咬起來韌而不脆，代表水氣跑進去了。
沒放涼就密封的罐子長霉或有霉味。
tips: 自家烤的要完全放涼才蓋蓋子。
用不透光的氣密罐；光線和溫度都會推著油脂走。
少量多次烤，不要一次烤一公斤。
撒進沙拉或湯之前，先吃幾顆確認。

faq.a: 氣密罐放陰涼、乾燥、避光的櫥櫃，6 個月。
無鹽的話不需要，而且它沒有公布冷藏期限。加鹽或裹油的版本，在潮濕的廚房裡放進氣密罐冷藏會有幫助。

faq.q: 怎麼判斷烤南瓜籽壞了？
faq.a: 吃幾顆。油耗的種子會苦、帶點腥。只是變韌的話那是受潮，不是腐敗。
